assumptions: Python 3.12+ standard library; plugin home from plugin_registry.home_path; upstream pinned at agent-lightning main bc3a9e80 and v0.x 6db3c73d; owner decisions L1-L5 of 2026-11-08.
compatibility: Additive. Registry schema id unchanged; a registry storing lightning lab is refused by earlier plugin versions (stated in setup effects). No existing output changes.
domain: Braid Lightning foundations: configuration profile, content-free rollout and event records, private run store and setup consent.
execution_contract: executionAuthorization stays false; no BL.0 code launches a process, opens a socket, calls a model or exposes an MCP tool; runs do not exist yet.
hypotheses: None; engineering specification with no scientific claim.
observation_contract: Deterministic unit tests record refusal codes, bytes and digests; no host or model is observed.

scenarios.given: the four ADRs, the program and the configuration contract

obtained_evidence.command: Owner review of the program, spec, ADRs 0039-0042 and the configuration contract through guided interactive questions (2026-11-08)
obtained_evidence.limits: Covers governance and scope (T001) only; human_review of the frozen candidate is separate. Tracking (procedure_009): milestones BL.0-BL.5 #29-#34 and SPEC-076 under Deferred #24 published by scoped reconciliation after PRs #1164, #1171 and #1251; re-audit returned no operations.
obtained_evidence.outcome: ADR 0039, 0040 and 0041 accepted; ADR 0042 proposed and deferred; SPEC-071 OD-1 decided (OAuth token from the environment). Decision record docs/development/FOUNDER_DECISIONS_20261108.md.

scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound test or procedure record: command, hashes, outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: each decision is recorded with its date and the ADR status reflects the owner decision; nothing is accepted by this specification.

requirements.text: Governance records: ADRs 0039-0042 exist as Proposed with context, decision, alternatives and consequences; 0039 states the advisory boundary, EUR 0 subscription route, human-only promotion and the forecasting scope of the SPEC-034 to SPEC-037 no-fine-tuning statements; 0042 is deferred; track BL is registered in the roadmap and tracking files.

scenarios.given: the adapted modules and the inventory

obtained_evidence.limits: The inventory hashes were computed from the pinned upstream commits at authoring time; this run checks notices, not a fresh upstream download.
obtained_evidence.outcome: passed: Every adapted module starts with the AGPL SPDX line and names microsoft/agent-lightning and the MIT License; the upstream license is retained verbatim and the inventory binds both pinned commits and original file hashes.

scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound test or procedure record: command, hashes, outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: every adapted module names microsoft/agent-lightning and the MIT License, and every hash matches.
scenarios.when: the notice test runs and the inventory hashes are recomputed from the pinned commits

requirements.text: Provenance: the upstream MIT license is retained verbatim, THIRD_PARTY.md records both pinned commits, the inventory binds original file hashes, and every adapted module carries an AGPL SPDX line plus an upstream notice.

scenarios.given: valid and invalid rollout and event documents

obtained_evidence.limits: Deterministic unit inputs only; no host, model or store concurrency is exercised.
obtained_evidence.outcome: passed: Rollout and event records round-trip byte-identically; unknown, missing, duplicate and non-finite inputs are refused with closed codes; transitions follow upstream VALID_TRANSITIONS; records carry no free-text content fields.

scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound test or procedure record: command, hashes, outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: valid records round-trip byte-identically, invalid ones are refused with a closed code, and transitions outside upstream VALID_TRANSITIONS are refused.
scenarios.when: they are parsed, transitioned and re-serialized

requirements.text: Data model: immutable Rollout, Event, Reward and ModelRef records with exact keys, closed vocabularies, finite numbers, digests instead of content, canonical bytes and the upstream rollout state machine.

scenarios.given: the default profile and a corpus of invalid profiles

obtained_evidence.limits: Agreement is shown on the tested corpus, not proven for all documents; the schema check needs the jsonschema development dependency.
obtained_evidence.outcome: passed: Defaults validate with EUR 0, subscription route, human promotion and executionAuthorization false fixed; every invalid profile in the corpus is refused by both the validator and the published JSON Schema.

scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound test or procedure record: command, hashes, outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: both accept the defaults and both refuse every invalid profile; the validator returns the contract refusal code.
scenarios.when: the validator and the published schema evaluate them

requirements.text: Configuration: braid-lightning-config/v0.1 is validated with exact keys, closed enumerations, bounded integers and fixed constants (eurCap 0, subscription route, human promotion, executionAuthorization false), digested canonically, and published as a JSON Schema that agrees with the validator.

obtained_evidence.limits: Prompts are simulated with patched input(); terminal behaviour on Windows is not exercised.
obtained_evidence.outcome: passed: Interactive and non-interactive previews write nothing; only the exact preview digest applies; a stale or wrong digest and --apply without --non-interactive are refused; validate and status report the profile.

scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound test or procedure record: command, hashes, outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: the preview writes nothing, a wrong or stale digest is refused, and the exact digest writes a private profile that validates.
scenarios.when: the owner previews and then applies a profile

requirements.text: Wizard: lightning init asks or takes flags, previews effects and digests without writing, and writes only with --apply and the exact preview digest while the prior file bytes still match; validate and status inspect the profile.

obtained_evidence.limits: Single-process tests; the lock refuses a second writer but concurrent writers are not stress-tested.
obtained_evidence.outcome: passed: Run directories and files stay owner-only; content-bearing, unknown and mismatched kinds write nothing; symlinks and tampered lines are refused; sweep removes only expired runs and purge only the selected run.

scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound test or procedure record: command, hashes, outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: modes stay owner-only, refused kinds write nothing, tampering is detected, expired runs are removed and purge deletes only the selected run.
scenarios.when: records are appended, tampered, swept and purged

requirements.text: Store: private per-run directories, append-only canonical JSON lines under an exclusive lock, refusal of symlinks, unknown and content-bearing kinds, tamper detection on read, retention sweep and purge.

obtained_evidence.limits: Registry behaviour only; reconnect behaviour of a running MCP server is unchanged and not exercised here.
obtained_evidence.outcome: passed: plugin setup --lightning lab stores the key with effects lines; off removes it and restores the earlier registry bytes and digest; unknown modes are refused; the setup skill describes the step without choosing for the user.

scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound test or procedure record: command, hashes, outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: lab is stored with effects lines, off removes the key and restores the earlier digest, and unknown modes are refused.
scenarios.when: lab is applied and then off

requirements.text: Setup opt-in: plugin setup --lightning off|lab previews and applies an optional registry key that is never stored as off and enters the configuration digest only when not off; the setup skill describes it only when asked.

obtained_evidence.limits: Static import inspection; it does not prove the absence of every possible side effect.
obtained_evidence.outcome: passed: BL.0 modules import only the standard library and local Braid Lightning or registry modules, import no socket, subprocess, http, urllib or asyncio, and no MCP module mentions Braid Lightning.

scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound test or procedure record: command, hashes, outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: only allowed imports appear and no MCP module mentions Braid Lightning.
scenarios.when: their imports and the MCP modules are inspected

requirements.text: Boundaries: BL.0 modules import only the standard library and local Braid Lightning or registry modules, open no socket, launch no process, expose no MCP tool and emit executionAuthorization false.

scientific_limits: Engineering only. Passing tests establish configured behaviour on the tested inputs, not optimization benefit, which SPEC-072 measures.
scope: Specification and delivery of BL.0: ADRs 0039-0042 (proposed), MIT vendoring provenance, lightning_schema, lightning_config with wizard, lightning_store, and the plugin setup lightning consent key.
